crops.title: Crop catalog
crops.subtitle: Author the Crop → Variety → Strain taxonomy. Codes are permanent (they anchor the canonical path); retiring hides a node without deleting it.
crops.readonlyHint: You have read-only access — editing needs the crop-catalog management capability.
crops.empty: No crops in the catalog yet.
crops.cropOnlyHint: This crop is set to “Crop only”, so it has no varieties.

platformHealth.title: Cross-tenant integration health
platformHealth.subtitle: Per-tenant rollup of weather + imagery sync status. Click a row to drill into that tenant. Refreshes every 30 seconds.
platformHealth.empty: No active tenants on the platform.

platformAdmins.title: Platform admins
platformAdmins.subtitle: Manage who has PlatformAdmin or PlatformSupport access. Mirrors the Keycloak `platform_role` user attribute.
platformAdmins.empty: No platform admins yet — bootstrap one via env vars.
platformAdmins.inviteHint: Creates a Keycloak user (or reuses an existing one) and sets the platform_role attribute. They'll receive a password-reset email.

invite.kcPending: Operator must finish provisioning via kcadm.sh — DB rows landed.

owner.title: Tenant owner
owner.subtitle: Platform's only user-mgmt touchpoint after tenant creation. Pick a new owner from this tenant's existing members; everything else lives in AgriPulse.
owner.newOwnerLabel: New owner (must already be a member of this tenant)
owner.noCandidates: No other admins on this tenant. Invite one via AgriPulse → Settings → Users first.
owner.assignIntro: Seed the first TenantOwner — invite a new user or promote an existing tenant member.

integrations.title: Integration defaults
integrations.subtitle: Set tenant-tier defaults for weather, imagery, and detection. The tenant owner can override these values inside AgriPulse — Platform's job is to seed sensible starting values.
integrations.loadFailed: Could not load tenant integration values.

admins.title: Tenant admins
admins.subtitle: Add or remove TenantAdmins for this tenant. Owner transfer requires a slug confirmation.
admins.ownerHint: Tenant owner — use Transfer ownership to move this role.

invite.kcPending: Operator must provision via kcadm.sh — DB rows landed.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.body: This will move TenantOwner from {{from}} to {{to}}.
transfer.confirmHint: Type the tenant slug to confirm: {{slug}}

defaults.title: Platform defaults
defaults.subtitle: Default settings every tenant inherits from. Tenants can override at their own tier.
defaults.readonlyHint: You don't have platform.manage_defaults — values are read-only.

guard.forbiddenBody: You don't have permission to manage tenants. Sign in with a PlatformAdmin account.

list.title: Tenants
list.subtitle: Create, suspend, restore, or delete customer tenants.
list.empty: No tenants yet. Create the first one to get started.

create.title: New tenant
create.subtitle: Provision a tenant with an initial owner.

fields.slugHelp: URL-safe identifier, 3–32 chars, lowercase letters/digits/hyphens. Permanent.
fields.name: Display name
fields.ownerEmailHelp: Required. The TenantOwner is provisioned in Keycloak and assigned the role at creation.

errors.slugConflict: A tenant with this slug already exists.
errors.contactEmailInvalid: Contact email must be a valid address.
errors.ownerEmailInvalid: Owner email must be a valid address.
errors.createFailed: Could not create tenant. Please try again.

review.ownerNote: An UPDATE_PASSWORD email will be sent to {{email}}.
review.noOwnerNote: No owner specified — Keycloak provisioning is skipped. You can complete it later via the retry endpoint.

success.title: Tenant created
success.noOwner: Tenant ready. Provision the Keycloak owner manually or via the retry endpoint when ready.
success.pendingProvision: Tenant created, but Keycloak provisioning failed. Use 'Retry provisioning' on the detail page once the issue is resolved.

detail.title: Tenant detail
detail.subtitle: Profile, settings, and lifecycle actions.
detail.comingSoon: Lifecycle actions (suspend / reactivate / delete / purge) will appear here in PR-F.

banner.suspended: This tenant is suspended. Sign-ins are blocked.
banner.pending_delete: This tenant is marked for deletion. Purge eligible {{when}}.
banner.pending_provision: Provisioning pending — Keycloak invite hasn't completed yet.

suspend.title: Suspend tenant
suspend.body: Sign-ins for this tenant will be blocked within ~30 seconds. Existing data is preserved.

requestDelete.title: Mark tenant for deletion
requestDelete.body: Starts the {{days}}-day grace window. After that, the tenant can be hard-purged. Cancellation returns the tenant to suspended.

purge.title: Purge tenant — irreversible
purge.body: This will DROP SCHEMA the tenant, delete public rows, and remove the Keycloak group + users. There is no undo.
purge.forceWarning: Use only when authorised — bypasses the {{days}}-day cooling-off period.

backfill.title: Backfill
backfill.subtitle: Load historical imagery and weather for a farm, and compute indices over data already stored.
backfill.started: Run started. Follow it on the Runs tab.

hint.imagery: Sentinel-2 scenes from CDSE. Raw bands only. Consumes processing units.
hint.weather: Hourly observations from the Open-Meteo archive. Free, no quota.
hint.imageryIndices: NDVI, NDMI, NDRE, SAVI, EVI, NDWI and GNDVI, recomputed per stored scene.
hint.weatherIndices: GDD, ET₀ and rainfall accumulations projected into daily weather indices.
hint.rawOnly: Backfill loads raw data only. Compute indices afterwards from the Indices tab.
hint.indicesFree: Runs over data already stored — no provider calls and no processing units.

estimate.title: Before you run this
estimate.units: Roughly {{units}} processing units. This is an estimate, not a quota reading.
estimate.noImagerySubs: This farm has no active imagery subscriptions — an imagery backfill would fetch nothing. Configure them on the farm first.
estimate.noWeatherSubs: This farm has no active weather subscriptions — a weather backfill would fetch nothing. Configure them on the farm first.

dialog.irreversible: This cannot be undone. Archiving is reversible — purging is not.
dialog.previewError: Could not load the impact report.
dialog.submitError: The purge could not be started.
dialog.dryRunStillOk: You can still run a dry run — it changes nothing.

blockedShort.tenant_not_suspended: Tenant is active — suspend it first.

result.dryRunTitle: Dry run complete — nothing was deleted

data.resetAllHint: Removes every farm and block and all their data. Keeps the tenant, its users, settings and integration keys. Requires the tenant to be suspended first.
data.loadError: Could not load this tenant's farms.

orphans.title: Orphaned data
orphans.hint: Rows and schemas left behind by earlier deletions. Read-only — scanning changes nothing.
orphans.straySchemas: Tenant schemas with no tenant row: {{schemas}}

cropAttrs.title: Attributes — {{crop}}
cropAttrs.subtitle: Typed fields that appear on this crop's block assignments. Definitions resolve deepest-wins across crop → variety → strain.
cropAttrs.previewHint: This is the form a user sees. Change a gating answer to watch the gated fields appear.
cropAttrs.previewEmpty: Define an attribute to see the form it produces.
cropAttrs.empty: No attributes defined for this crop yet.
cropAttrs.attachHelp: Attach deeper to override an inherited definition of the same code.
cropAttrs.groupHelp: Fields sharing a group render together under one heading.
cropAttrs.gateNeedsValue: Pick at least one value, or the gate never opens.
cropAttrs.noGateTargets: No single-choice or yes/no field to gate on yet.

err.code: Use letters, numbers, _ or -, up to 32 characters.
err.reserved: This code is already a built-in field. Pick another.
err.optionCode: Every option needs a valid code.
err.optionNames: Every option needs an English and an Arabic name.

observer.title: Observer
observer.subtitle: End-to-end view of the indices pipeline: raw scenes, per-pixel maths, cell and block aggregates, trends, and what they produced.
observer.pickFarmFirst: Pick a tenant and a farm to begin. Observer is farm-scoped — the pipeline only means something against a specific set of blocks.
observer.trendAmbiguous: This farm holds aggregates from more than one product. The daily trend rollup has no product dimension, so trend coverage cannot be attributed to the selected product alone.
observer.consumersProxy: Consumers are counted by creation time in this window, not by proven descent from these scenes.
observer.mixedCalcVersions: Two calculation versions in this window — the trend line mixes methodologies

rail.title: Selection
rail.noScenes: No scenes have ever been ingested for this farm.

diagnosis.generic: {{count}} of {{expected}} expected outputs are missing at this stage.
diagnosis.acquired: {{count}} scene(s) were discovered but never downloaded. Check the provider errors in the scene list.
diagnosis.indices: {{count}} scene(s) downloaded successfully but wrote no aggregates — the job reads as succeeded because the download succeeded, so index computation is where they died.
diagnosis.cells: {{count}} scene(s) on gridded blocks produced no cell aggregates. Blocks with no grid governing the scene's time are already excluded from this count.
diagnosis.trend: {{count}} block-day(s) have aggregates but no daily-trend bucket. The trend rollup refreshes on a rolling window, so history written outside it stays invisible until a manual refresh.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.noAggregates: This scene wrote no index aggregates.

tooltip.cloudPct: Cloud cover across the whole scene as reported by the provider — not measured for this block specifically.
tooltip.validPct: Valid pixels divided by the block's pixel footprint. A low value means the number came from a fraction of the field.
tooltip.indices: How many of the product's supported indices wrote an aggregate row for this scene.
